mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Career Development Plan' (transferable skills row) and 'Career perspectives and employability' section
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly targets an increased set of research and transferable skills leading to improved employability. training_and_career_development.md 'Career perspectives and employability' describes completing the fellow's progression from plant physiologist/agronomist to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist, and the CDP transferable-skills table lists research integrity, open science/FAIR, generative-AI literacy, grant writing, IP and exploitation, project management and science communication. Employability relevance is stated across universities, research organisations, precision-agriculture/irrigation companies, EO organisations and FMIS providers.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' and 'Non-academic placement' sections; project_summary.json operational_evaluator_placement_host
mappings.mapping_description: New mind-sets through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience are directly instantiated: international mobility (fellow relocating to HUN-REN ATK, Hungary), inter-sectoral exposure (AgroVIR non-academic placement M25-M30 and Krumatic software collaboration), and interdisciplinary integration (plant stress physiology + agricultural data science + hyperspectral/UAV/EO). The two-way transfer of knowledge section makes the interdisciplinary/inter-sectoral fusion explicit.

Enhanced networking and communication with peers and the public is addressed by the 'Networking, communication and public engagement' section: at least two peer-reviewed publications (P1, P2), conference presentations, MATE/HUN-REN/ELTE seminars, practitioner-oriented demonstrations, an AgroVIR evaluation session, and a public-facing demonstration; operator-preserved measure of one public field demonstration with farmers and one public-facing article per year.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers' section
mappings.mapping_description: Alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers is addressed at instrument level through the jointly-established Career Development Plan (D1.3) and the documented supervision/training arrangements. The concept is scrupulous: it explicitly declines to claim HRS4R/HR Excellence status for HUN-REN ATK unless evidenced, so the mechanism is CDP + supervision rather than an unverified HR award.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision cadence and governance' and 'Career Development Plan' sections
mappings.mapping_description: Enhanced quality and sustainability of research training and supervision is addressed by a defined supervision structure: primary supervisor (Prof. Janda, ATK) plus co-supervisor (Prof. Jung, ELTE), weekly one-to-one meetings, monthly written progress record, quarterly CDP review, and a Project Steering Group issuing go/no-go verdicts at defined milestones. Two-way transfer of knowledge and structured decision rights evidence training quality.

Increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of participating organisations is evidenced by the 'Host capacity, attractiveness and visibility' section: HUN-REN ATK's track record hosting the MSCA Individual Fellowship LANDRACES and current Horizon Europe participation (COUSIN, AI4SoilHealth, TUdi), ELTE's spatial-sensing environment, and the international Hungary-Bulgaria collaboration network. The strategic positioning frames the project as building institutional visibility.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' section
mappings.mapping_description: Stronger R&I capacity and better transfer of knowledge among participating organisations is addressed by the deliberately complementary two-way transfer: the fellow contributes agronomy, plant physiology, physiological phenotyping and the DrR concept, while host/partners provide agricultural data science, uncertainty modelling, hyperspectral/UAV/EO integration and research-to-software translation. Publications (P1, P2, optional third) and the crop-configurable framework represent enhanced R&I output.

mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: project_brief/training_and_career_development.md — 'Teaching and education' section (incl. supersession note mapping EO-08)
mappings.mapping_description: Regular feedback of research results into teaching and education is addressed by the 'Teaching and education' section: guest lectures, seminars and practical sessions at MATE and, where possible, the Agricultural University of Plovdiv, linking plant-stress physiology with UAV/EO monitoring and agricultural data science, building on the fellow's prior five years of university teaching. The 2026-08-28 supersession note explicitly maps EO-08 to this guest-session route after the host switch to a non-university organisation.
